name: Nielsen Norman Group Articles Component

title.zh: Nielsen Norman Group Articles · 按实际UX问题找到文章

description.zh: Use the actual observed native CookieYes Close control before capturing the full first heuristic explanation, illustration and tips; preserve obstructed originals. Nielsen Norman Group 的 Articles 入口按 UX 主题、作者与发布时间组织文章和视频，并提供只看文章的筛选。当前文章例子讨论十条可用性启发式，第一条系统状态可见性完整显示解释、地图插图与三条建议。可从问题或主题进入具体研究内容；本条是出版内容入口，课程、咨询与下载海报属于相关范围，不能据文章就声称全部服务免费。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Nielsen Norman Group Articles (https://www.nngroup.com/articles/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: Use the actual observed native CookieYes Close control before capturing the full first heuristic explanation, illustration and tips; preserve obstructed originals.


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
